big_idea: Qareeb makes grocery shopping as quick and reliable as walking to your neighborhood shop—just faster and without the hassle. By connecting local vendors to customers in under 20 minutes, we bring affordability, convenience, and community together in one seamless app. This isn’t just delivery; it’s rediscovering the shops you love, made effortless.
key_visual: A bustling Cairo street scene gently transformed into a fast-forward moment with motion blur around a young father and his toddler holding a bag of fresh groceries. In the background, a small shopkeeper smiles while packing an order labeled 'قريب' (Qareeb). The focus is warm and human, blending everyday authenticity with dynamic energy.
image_prompt: A cinematic street scene in Cairo at golden hour, showing a young father and toddler running hand-in-hand while holding a green reusable Qareeb grocery tote. The background is blurred with motion streaks showing vendors, motorcycles, and colorful storefronts. Text 'قريب' is subtly glowing in Arabic calligraphy on a sign. Colorful yet warm, highly detailed, photorealistic, shot on 35mm film with soft sunset light.
typography: Primary: 'Segoe UI' (Headings) — clean, modern, reliable. Secondary: 'Amiri' — traditional yet friendly. Accents (script/arabic): 'Kufam' — local calligraphic touch.
